# HWMultiTex <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [World](Blitz3D-World)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HWMultiTex:Void enable:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | In | Int32 | required | True to use multitexturing when the card has it. |

## Description

Switches multitexturing on or off, so that a triangle with several textures is drawn in one pass or in several.

## Differences

* Accepted and ignored. Textures are always combined in a single pass.
